products.title: Speckled serving bowl
products.description: A softly rounded serving bowl for shared snacks, bright fruit and long lunches. Its gently uneven glaze makes each piece feel a little different.

products.title: Soft-check table runner
products.description: An easy cotton layer for the middle of the table, woven in a quiet check and finished with a short fringe.

products.title: Stoneware water carafe
products.description: A useful, hand-finished carafe that feels just as at home beside the bed as it does on a dinner table.

products.title: Window-garden planter
products.description: A small planter for herbs, cuttings and sunny ledges. The drainage tray is included.

products.title: Soft-glow candle cups
products.description: A pair of simple candle cups with a warm, low glow for unhurried evenings and little celebrations.

products.title: Market-day carry tote
products.description: A roomy, reusable carry-all for market finds, library books or the bits and pieces that come along for the day.

story: Mitti & Loom is a fictional independent studio made for this demo. We believe the best everyday objects are useful, warm and made to be kept. This sample catalogue uses original placeholder names and copy; no third-party store content or product imagery is included.
